strongest_scope: Bounded iid priors: positive h_n=n^-4 and arbitrary measurable positive selectors in an O(n^-5/2) window retain the known minimax average-regret order; this includes a specified finite-thinning CV/refit shrinking grid.
remaining_gap: General-grid unmodified adaptive selection and full-data refitting, including practical moderate h; unrestricted prior and compound-regret variants not proved.
